proposed_widenings.name: emit_light
proposed_widenings.justification: The item can be toggled to emit a bounded dim-light aura. The current surface has no effect atom for producing or suppressing light.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can cause it to emit green Dim Light out to 10 feet ... or you can extinguish the light"

proposed_widenings.name: runtime item-form predicate
proposed_widenings.justification: Several riders apply only while the same item is currently in Quarterstaff form or in Quarterstaff and 10-Foot Pole forms. The surface can alter item kind, but it cannot predicate passive or triggered mechanics on the item's current authored form.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "Acrobatic Assist (Quarterstaff and 10-Foot Pole Forms Only)" and "Attack Deflection (Quarterstaff Form Only)"

proposed_widenings.name: grant_weapon_property_with_return
proposed_widenings.justification: The item temporarily gains the Thrown property with explicit normal/long range values, and after a ranged attack it deterministically returns to the wielder's hand. The current surface has no atom for granting weapon properties or for this immediate return rider on a weapon attack.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "This weapon has the Thrown property with a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 120 feet. Immediately after you make a ranged attack with the weapon, it flies back to your hand."

notes: The top-level kind does fit: this is a magic item and its overall shape wants a composite of passive, activation, and triggered_reaction parts. I did not author content because the emitted-light toggle, runtime form-conditional gating, and thrown-and-return weapon behavior cannot be represented honestly in the current surface.
